dialog.about.body.source: Explore stitch order, thread colors, jumps, trims, and machine commands before production. Preview the design stitch by stitch, switch rendering styles, and export what you see.
dialog.about.body.translation: Esplora l-ordni tal-ponti, il-kuluri tal-ħajt, il-qbiż, it-trims, u l-kmandi tal-magna qabel il-produzzjoni. Ara l-preview tad-disinn ponti b'ponti, ibdel l-istili tar-rendering, u esporta dak li tara.

dialog.about.tagline.source: Interactive embroidery simulation, inspection, and export.
dialog.about.tagline.translation: Simulazzjoni interattiva ta' rakkmu, spezzjoni, u esportazzjoni.

dialog.calibrate.info.source: Hold a ruler against the screen and drag the slider until the bar below is exactly 100 mm long, then press OK.
dialog.calibrate.info.translation: Żomm riga kontra l-iskrin u drag is-slider sakemm il-bar hawn taħt ikun eżattament 100 mm twil, imbagħad agħfas OK.

dialog.export.copy.tooltip.source: Copy the full-resolution image to the clipboard

dialog.export.save.tooltip.source: Save the image to a file

dialog.language.restart_message.source: The language has been set to {language}. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.restart_message.translation: Il-lingwa ġiet issettjata għal {language}. Erġa' ibda InkSim issa biex tapplikaha?

dialog.language.system_default_message.source: The system default language will be used. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.system_default_message.translation: Il-lingwa default tas-sistema se tintuża. Erġa' ibda InkSim issa biex tapplikaha?

dialog.language.windows_closed.source: All open InkSim windows will be closed and the current file reopened.
dialog.language.windows_closed.translation: Il-finestri kollha miftuħa ta' InkSim se jingħalqu u l-fajl attwali se jerġa' jinfetaħ.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.source: See output.err for the error details.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_timeout.translation: L-esportazzjoni CSV ta' Ink/Stitch qabżet il-limitu taż-żmien.

dialog.open_browser.converting.translation: Qed titħaddem l-esportazzjoni CSV ta' Ink/Stitch...

dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.source: Open this SVG in a new Inkscape window.
dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.translation: Iftaħ dan l-SVG f'tieqa ġdida ta' Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.empty.source: No supported files in this folder.

dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.translation: Ikklikkja darbtejn fuq il-folder biex tara l-fajls tiegħu.

dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.translation: Ikklikkja darbtejn fuq il-folder biex tara l-fajls tiegħu.

dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.source: Inkscape is required to edit SVG files.
dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.translation: Inkscape huwa meħtieġ biex teditja fajls SVG.

dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.source: A configured active Ink/Stitch installation is required for SVG preview.
dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.translation: Hija meħtieġa installazzjoni attiva u kkonfigurata ta' Ink/Stitch biex turi previżjoni tal-SVG.

dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.source: Generate stitch data from this SVG using the active Ink/Stitch installation.
dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.translation: Iġġenera dejta tal-ponti minn dan l-SVG billi tuża l-installazzjoni attiva ta' Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.source: Cannot run the active Ink/Stitch script or its configured Python launcher.
dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.translation: Ma jistax jitħaddem l-iskript attiv ta' Ink/Stitch jew il-programm Python ikkonfigurat għalih.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.source: Ink/Stitch extension: could not check. Use Tools... to retry.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.translation: Estensjoni ta' Ink/Stitch: ma setgħetx tiġi ċċekkjata. Uża Għodod... biex terġa' tipprova.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not found in Inkscape's extension directories.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.translation: Estensjoni ta' Ink/Stitch: ma nstabitx fid-direttorji tal-estensjonijiet ta' Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.source: Ink/Stitch extension: cannot check until Inkscape is configured.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.translation: Estensjoni ta' Ink/Stitch: ma tistax tiġi ċċekkjata qabel ma jiġi kkonfigurat Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not checked yet. Use Tools... to check.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.translation: Estensjoni ta' Ink/Stitch: għadha ma ġietx iċċekkjata. Uża Għodod... biex tiċċekkja.

dialog.open_browser.status.svg_needs_ink.source: SVG preview runs directly through Ink/Stitch; editing requires Inkscape.
dialog.open_browser.status.svg_needs_ink.translation: Il-previżjoni tal-SVG issir direttament permezz ta' Ink/Stitch; biex teditja hemm bżonn Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.status.svg_ready.source: SVG preview runs directly through Ink/Stitch; Inkscape is used only for editing.
dialog.open_browser.status.svg_ready.translation: Il-previżjoni tal-SVG issir direttament permezz ta' Ink/Stitch; Inkscape jintuża biss għall-editjar.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.source: SVG source. Inkscape is required for stitch preview.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.translation: Sors SVG. Inkscape huwa meħtieġ għall-previżjoni tal-ponti.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.source: SVG source. Choose Preview to generate stitch data with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.translation: Sors SVG. Agħżel Previżjoni biex tiġġenera dejta tal-ponti b'Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.svg_invalid.source: The SVG could not be rendered.

dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.source: This SVG is too large to preview here.
dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.translation: Dan l-SVG huwa kbir wisq biex turi previżjoni tiegħu hawn.

dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.source: Could not create a temporary preview file: {error}
dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.translation: Ma setax jinħoloq fajl temporanju għall-previżjoni: {error}

dialog.open_browser.unsupported.source: This file type cannot be opened in InkSim.
dialog.open_browser.unsupported.translation: Dan it-tip ta' fajl ma jistax jinfetaħ f'InkSim.

integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.source: Could not save the Inkscape extension status: {error}
integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.translation: Ma setax jiġi ssejvjat l-istatus tal-estensjoni ta' Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_none.source: No InkSim extension folders were found.
integration.inkscape.inksim_none.translation: Ma nstab l-ebda folder tal-estensjonijiet ta' InkSim.

integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.translation: Ma setgħux jiġu eżaminati l-folders tal-estensjonijiet ta' Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: Could not install InkSim's Inkscape extensions: {error}
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Ma setgħux jiġu installati l-estensjonijiet ta' Inkscape ta' InkSim: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: InkSim's Inkscape extensions were installed or updated in {path}. Restart Inkscape to load them.
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: L-estensjonijiet ta' Inkscape ta' InkSim ġew installati jew aġġornati f'{path}. Erġa' ibda Inkscape biex jitgħabbew.

integration.inkscape.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found on the system path.

integration.inkscape.preferences_read_fa.translation: Ma setgħux jinqraw il-preferenzi ta' Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.preferences_write_f.translation: Ma setgħux jiġu aġġornati l-preferenzi ta' Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.probe_failed.source: Could not read Inkscape extension directories: {error}
integration.inkscape.probe_failed.translation: Ma setgħux jinqraw id-direttorji tal-estensjonijiet ta' Inkscape: {error}

integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the new Python interpreter.
integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.translation: Erġa' ibda Inkscape biex tapplika l-interpretu Python il-ġdid.

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Could not remove the old InkSim extension folder: {error}
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Ma setax jitneħħa l-folder l-antik tal-estensjonijiet ta' InkSim: {error}

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Old InkSim extension folders were removed. Restart Inkscape to refresh its extension list.
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Il-folders l-antiki tal-estensjonijiet ta' InkSim tneħħew. Erġa' ibda Inkscape biex tiġġedded il-lista tal-estensjonijiet.

integration.inkscape.report.active_inkst.translation: L-installazzjoni attiva ta' Ink/Stitch ġiet aġġornata: {path}

integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.source: Could not save the InkSim configuration: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.translation: Ma setgħetx tiġi ssejvjata l-konfigurazzjoni ta' InkSim: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.source: Saved the detected setup to the InkSim configuration.
integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.translation: Is-setup misjub ġie ssejvjat fil-konfigurazzjoni ta' InkSim.

integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.translation: Ma setgħux jiġu eżaminati l-folders tal-estensjonijiet ta' InkSim: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.inkstitch_no.translation: Ma nstabet l-ebda installazzjoni ta' Ink/Stitch.

integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found; the preference was left unchanged.
integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.translation: Il-programm meħtieġ '{command}' ma nstabx; il-preferenza tħalliet kif kienet.

integration.inkscape.report.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found. Choose its executable to inspect the setup.
integration.inkscape.report.not_found.translation: Inkscape ma nstabx. Agħżel l-eżekutibbli tiegħu biex teżamina s-setup.

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Could not check or update the Python interpreter: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Ma setax jiġi ċċekkjat jew aġġornat l-interpretu Python: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Python interpreter preference was not checked because the user extensions directory is unavailable.
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Il-preferenza tal-interpretu Python ma ġietx iċċekkjata għax id-direttorju tal-estensjonijiet tal-utent mhuwiex disponibbli.

integration.inkscape.report.restart.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the updated interpreter.
integration.inkscape.report.restart.translation: Erġa' ibda Inkscape biex tapplika l-interpretu aġġornat.

integration.inkscape.report.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds.
integration.inkscape.report.timeout.translation: Inkscape ma rrispondiex fi żmien {seconds} sekonda.

integration.inkscape.report.waiting.source: Choose an Inkscape executable to inspect.
integration.inkscape.report.waiting.translation: Agħżel eżekutibbli ta' Inkscape biex teżamina.

integration.inkscape.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds. Another Inkscape instance or an extension may be blocking communication. Close other Inkscape instances or disable the blocking extension, then try again.
integration.inkscape.timeout.translation: Inkscape ma rrispondiex fi żmien {seconds} sekonda. Jista' jkun hemm istanza oħra ta' Inkscape jew estensjoni li qed timblokka l-komunikazzjoni. Agħlaq l-istanzi l-oħra ta' Inkscape jew iddiżattiva l-estensjoni li qed timblokka, imbagħad erġa' pprova.

integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found. Install the uvr tool yourself with `uv tool install uvr`, then run this configuration again. InkSim will not install it.
integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.translation: Il-programm meħtieġ '{command}' ma nstabx. Installa l-għodda uvr int stess bil-kmand `uv tool install uvr`, imbagħad erġa' ħaddem din il-konfigurazzjoni. InkSim mhux se jinstallaha.

integration.inkstitch.not_found.translation: Ma nstabet l-ebda installazzjoni ta' Ink/Stitch.

message.no_file_to_export.source: No embroidery file is loaded to export.
message.no_file_to_export.translation: M'hemm l-ebda fajl tar-rakkmu mgħobbi biex tesporta.

status.line_settings.reset.source: Reset line width and shading factors
status.line_settings.reset.translation: Irrisettja l-wisa' tal-linja u l-fatturi tad-dell

status.line_settings.tooltip.source: Click to adjust dark factor, light factor and line width
status.line_settings.tooltip.translation: Ikklikkja biex taġġusta l-fattur skur, il-fattur ċar u l-wisa' tal-linja

status.mode.bottom_view.source: Bottom view (draw later stitches under earlier ones)
status.mode.bottom_view.translation: Veduta t'isfel (iġbed ponti aktar tard taħt dawk aktar bikrija)

status.mode.jump.source: Cycle jump display: off, all, risky only
status.mode.jump.translation: Iċċikla l-wiri tal-qbiż: mitfi, kollha, riskjużi biss
